[EN] I sincerely hope you're not looking to blame me for this. I didn't do...whatever was done. I have an alibi.

Oh, wait—my alibi ran screaming from here.

I still didn't do it.
[ES] Espero sinceramente que no busques culparme de esto. Yo no hice... lo que sea que se haya hecho. Tengo una coartada.

Ay, espera... mi coartada salió corriendo de aquí a los gritos.

Aun así, yo no lo hice.

[EN] Are you ready to go to Hallie?Go.Go to Hallie.
[ES] ¿Estás listo para ir con Hallie?Go.Go to Hallie.
